# gl_test cases 211 (msaablend) and 190 (blendonce) on the NanoPC-T6 under the
# board's Mesa 25.0.7, for the frame builder's blend-shader descriptors
# (src/mali/frame_blend_tests.rs, src/mali/frame_msaa_tests.rs): each draw
# Mesa ran with a blend shader, its command-stream words from the first after
# the frame's previous RUN_IDVS to its own RUN_IDVS, the descriptor buffer its
# d50 names and the blend shader's buffer. Cut by
# tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py's rules with a hand-picked command-stream start
# (a frame's later draw has no REQ_RESOURCE of its own).
#   mesa-msaablend-rtt.pandecode sha256 c96c558f52c73828282259dbd42cd92d4dc24ab24e67687b0404bca073d052b6
#     211 on the backend contract's 4x target (an RGBA8 texture behind
#     glFramebufferTexture2DMultisampleEXT(..., 4)): the frame's second draw,
#     the blended quad (mesa-msaablend-rtt)
#   mesa-blendonce.pandecode sha256 d6b31ffd39088a2d6a1b34304580a0cda9a04bae1b09c4180fa476770f2c941f
#     190 into a 64x64 RGBA8 pbuffer: the third draw, column 3, GL_MIN on the
#     colour (mesa-blendonce-c3), and the fourth, column 4,
#     ONE_MINUS_DST_ALPHA / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA (mesa-blendonce-c4)
#   (0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-24-mesa-refs4/mesa/, cases.c c92813fc)
